_meta.name: TypoCH habitat typology — code/name reference (levels 1–4, DE/FR/IT)
_meta.purpose: Authoritative code→name lookup for the BAFU Lebensraumkarte (ch.bafu.lebensraumkarte-schweiz) habitat overlay. Reused by the web app (web/js/config.js) and the Python CLI (python/) so habitat category names are not hardcoded twice.
_meta.typology: Delarze R., Gonseth Y., Eggenberg S., Vust M. (2015): Lebensräume der Schweiz. Ökologie – Gefährdung – Kennarten. 3. Aufl.
_meta.source_list: InfoFlora — Artenliste TypoCH / Liste des espèces / Lista delle specie (workbook, 2024-05-29), sheet 'TypoCH'.
_meta.map_layer: ch.bafu.lebensraumkarte-schweiz — BAFU Lebensraumkarte der Schweiz (WSL v1.2); served attributes typoch_de / typoch_fr / typoch_it.
_meta.code_normalization: The official 'Code TypoCH' uses a '.-' separator before the level-2 digit (e.g. '1.-1.0'); normalized here to plain dots ('1.1.0') to match the map layer's dotted code prefixes (e.g. '6.3.1 Buchenwald').
_meta.map_layer_depth: The Lebensraumkarte resolves to level-2 at minimum, level-3 where possible; it does not emit level-4.
_meta.license_note: TypoCH names © the cited authors / InfoFlora; consult the source for reuse terms. Habitat map + symbology © BAFU / WSL (EnviDat, opendata.swiss; CC-BY).
_meta.color_source: Official symbology of the BAFU/WSL Lebensraumkarte der Schweiz v1.1 (EnviDat: symbology_HabitatMap_v1_1_Group_TypoCH_20241025.zip, QGIS .qml), parsed to code→fill colour.
_meta.color_note: `color` on each type is the official map colour for that exact TypoCH code; codes finer than the map's symbology inherit their mapped group's colour. Level-1 entries use the mid-tone `l1_colors` representative — a legible member of each class's colour family for group swatches / single-colour-per-class rendering (the map itself reserves a paler tone for level-1-only pixels).
